page.tutorial.title: How do I charge my vehicle?
page.tutorial.subtitle-5: Find QR code or serial number
page.tutorial.text-0: To use the AC chargers of the ETIA network you need a Type 2 cable. DC fast chargers already include the cable.
page.tutorial.text-1: You can buy charging credits from the "Enter amount" button or select one of the quick options.
page.tutorial.text-2: Tap a charger on the map to view its availability status.
page.tutorial.text-3: In "View location" you will find all chargers at that charging location.
page.tutorial.text-4: Scan the QR code of the charger, or enter the serial number.
page.tutorial.text-5: On the side of Etia Alcor models, or on the front screen of Etia Lux models.
page.tutorial.text-6: Select for how long you want to charge your vehicle and press "Unlock". You can view the total credits cost before charging.
page.tutorial.text-7: Once finished charging, you can unplug the vehicle.

page.faq.title: FAQ
page.faq.question-1: How to operate on our public charging network?
page.faq.question-2: How does the payment and credits system work?
page.faq.question-3: Can I use credits on any charger in the network?
page.faq.question-4: What do the colors and states of chargers on the map mean?
page.faq.question-5: Can I stop the charge before it's done?
page.faq.question-6: Can I stay longer using the parking spot if I'm not using the charger?
page.faq.question-7: How long do credits last after I purchase them?
page.faq.answer-1: To use our chargers you need a Type 2 to Type 2 cable and the "Etia" mobile app, available for download on Android and iOS. You can find a tutorial on how to charge on the home screen.
page.faq.answer-2:
It is essential to understand that 1 credit = 1 kWh.

You can buy packs of 25, 50 or 75 credits, or purchase a custom amount.

Once you've purchased your charging credits, you can scan the QR code and start charging. If you charge for less time, the unused credits remain saved in your app and can be used later.

If your car cannot charge at the maximum power of the charging station, only the credits equivalent to the kW consumed will be deducted.
page.faq.answer-3: Yes. You can use your credits on any charger in the National Etia network (you can view it on the map).
page.faq.answer-4:
The charger states let you know the availability of each one.

Green = the charger is available and you can charge.

Yellow = the charging station is occupied.

White = the charger is not available for use.
page.faq.answer-5: Yes. You can stop the charge through the Mobile App by pressing the "Stop charge" button. If you didn't use all your credits, they will be saved for later use.
page.faq.answer-6: No. If you stay longer than the allotted time WITHOUT charging, you will receive a financial penalty.
page.faq.answer-8: No, currently no charger can be reserved. You can check availability by tapping on each charging station.

page.about.adaptability-text: We adapt quickly to changes and challenges in the environment, being flexible in our search for effective solutions. Adaptability is a key strength of our team. We are able to quickly adapt to new situations and challenges, and we are always looking for the best solutions to meet the needs of our clients.
